svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'JetBrains Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: One ticket, in order
svg.desc: The test writer writes the tests, and the store locks them before any code exists. Then each try goes from the builder to the gate and a reviewer, until one passes or a stop rule fires: the store writes its pass record and marks it a ready change, and with auto merge on, the driver has the store merge tier 1 and 2.

g.text: until one passes or a stop rule fires

svg.text: tier 2 and up: the change too
